# Gabe Atwell

> Portfolio of Gabe Atwell — custom web interfaces, fluid animations, and 3D experiences. I design, build, and maintain digital projects that feel intentional and tell a clear story.

## Main Pages
- [Home](https://atwell.dev/): Handcrafted frontend experiences built with SvelteKit, GSAP, and Three.js
- [Projects](https://atwell.dev/projects): Websites and interactive builds I've created and maintained
- [About](https://atwell.dev/about): Background, approach, and how I work

## Learning Resources
- [Three.js Blog](https://atwell.dev/threejs-blog): Practical guides and experiments covering scenes, lighting, models, animation, and more
- [Web Animations & CSS](https://atwell.dev/learn): Tutorials on modern CSS techniques and web animation

## Experiments
- [Frontend Experiments](https://atwell.dev/experiments): Interactive demos and technical explorations (also accessible by pressing Tab twice on any page)
